title: 7.15 El picnic de Sofía
unit_title: Everyday needs, plans and free time
unit_outcome: Say what hurts and why someone feels a certain way, describe what people are wearing and the weather as it happens, tell someone to put on or take off clothes, talk about what people like doing, invite and answer, ask someone to repeat or explain, talk about being sick, the months and seasons, compare with the biggest and the tallest, and say what people and animals can do and are good at.
goal: Help at Sofia's birthday picnic: find the guests by what they wear, what they are doing, what hurts and what they do in the rain, find the tallest and shortest child, and answer Ana's friends aloud about the party, why she is happy, what she likes doing, the weather and her birthday month.
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 7.15 Un día con amigos: A1 closes the course with friends meeting in the park; A1+ 7.15 closes A1+ Unit 7 at Sofia's birthday picnic in the park with no new language. The learner finds the guests by what they are wearing (7.3), what they are doing (A1+ 3.3, 7.6, 7.13), what hurts and who has a cough or is cold (7.1, 7.9), who wears what or runs in the rain (7.4), the tallest and shortest child and the boy between the girls (7.11, A1 6.6), and answers Sofia's invitation, Luis's Why …?, Diego's What do you like doing?, Is it raining now? and When is your birthday? aloud for Ana (7.7, 7.2, 7.6, 7.4 and 7.10).
speaking_outcome: Answer four friends aloud for Ana: accept Sofia's invitation, say why she is happy, what she likes doing, that it isn't raining and that her birthday is in May.
